dct_description_sm: These datasets accompany a paper published in Environmental Toxicology and Chemistry titled "Microplastics accumulation and microbiome alterations in the freshwater pulmonate snail, Planorbella pilsbryi". These data include measurements of microplastic accumulation in Planorbella pilsbryi tissues and biological responses (survival and reproduction) following exposure to microplastics of different sizes, shapes, polymer types, and conditions.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Microplastics accumulation and microbiome alterations in the freshwater pulmonate snail, Planorbella pilsbryi
